summary.en: Repaired the dataset (606 → 26,418 boxes; vans 0 → 420) and retrained with YOLOv8 to 0.873 mAP@0.5 on validation; the first YOLO-NAS model never exceeded ~0.4 confidence. Runs entirely in the browser via onnxruntime-web; shown at the program's showcase in Oct 2026.

title.zh: GStreamer × YOLOv8 即時推論管線

summary.en: H.264 hardware decoding (NVDEC) feeding ONNX object detection, with hand-written letterbox and NMS: 13.4 ms end-to-end p50 (70 FPS) with GPU inference, 7.3× faster than CPU inference, no dropped frames. A 4-way benchmark showed appsink drop=true discarding 44% of frames from a file source without lowering latency.
summary.zh: H.264 硬體解碼（NVDEC）接 ONNX 物件偵測，letterbox 與 NMS 自己寫：GPU 推論時端到端延遲 p50 13.4 ms（70 FPS），比 CPU 推論快 7.3 倍，沒有丟幀。四組對照實驗發現檔案來源開 appsink drop=true 會丟掉 44% 的影格，延遲卻沒有降低。

title.en: PPO vs. DQN for Autonomous Highway Driving

org.zh: 成功大學 — 強化學習課程論文

summary.en: From-scratch PPO + Double DQN with a parameter-matched Self-Attention vs. MLP ablation (n=5); episodic returns tie within 5.7% while deployed crash rates differ ~7× (DQN 11.3% vs. PPO 60–80%) — return alone is misleading for safety-critical control.
summary.zh: 從零實作 PPO 與 Double DQN，並做參數對齊的 Self-Attention vs. MLP 消融（n=5）；episodic return 差距 ≤5.7%，但碰撞率相差約 7×（DQN 11.3% vs. PPO 60–80%），證明單看 return 對安全關鍵控制具誤導性。
